title: When the Hollow Sings Anew
premise: Lena Underhill steals memories for coin, slipping along smuggler roads through the Thornfell mountains — until the night the border wards collapse, the stars vanish, and the kingdom of Vael is erased from every map and mind but hers. Hunted by the Hollow, a devouring silence that eats memory itself, Lena discovers she carries a stolen recollection that was never meant to leave the royal vault: the true name of the land, spoken by its dying queen. To restore Vael, Lena must return what they stole to the queen's forgotten heir — a warder named Sef who once loved them and now serves the enemy out of duty. In the end, Lena gives up their own dearest memories as the price of speaking the name aloud; Vael returns, the stars reignite, and Sef chooses love over duty by keeping one memory of Lena alive in place of his own.
about_author: A. M. Montrose is the pen name of a former archivist who spent a decade cataloguing letters no one ever claimed. They write fantasy about the things we keep, the things we sell, and the things we cannot bear to lose.

chapters.title: The Weight of Borrowed Years
chapters.summary: Lena's POV. A heist gone soft: instead of coin, Lena lifts a nobleman's first kiss from his sleeping mind. Establishes memory-theft magic, Lena's rules (never keep what you steal), and their loneliness. Emotional beat: wry competence masking hunger for connection.

chapters.title: Smuggler's Arithmetic
chapters.summary: Lena's POV. On the Thornfell pass, Lena bargains passage with old friend Brannoc, trading a stranger's childhood for safe road. We learn the wards hum louder each year and Lena hears them sing. Beat: uneasy belonging among outcasts.

chapters.title: The Night the Stars Went Out
chapters.summary: Lena's POV. The border wards shatter like glass; darkness swallows the sky; the country behind them simply stops being remembered. Lena alone recalls Vael's name. Beat: terror and vertigo as reality rewrites itself.

chapters.title: What the Silence Eats
chapters.summary: Brannoc's POV. Brannoc forgets his own daughter mid-sentence as the Hollow passes through camp. Lena realizes memories are food now. Beat: grief sharpening into resolve.

chapters.title: A Door Out of Nowhere
chapters.summary: Lena's POV. Rumor of an exodus gate at the drowned city of Cael Morath. Lena decides to find it — not to save Vael, just themselves. Beat: self-preservation as honest motive.

chapters.title: The Warder on the Road
chapters.summary: Sef's POV. Introduced hunting memory-thieves for the Hollow's human servants, the Gray Choir. He recognizes Lena's handiwork at a looted village — and remembers loving them. Beat: duty wrestling with old tenderness.

chapters.title: Two Thieves, One Road
chapters.summary: Lena's POV. Sef corners Lena; instead of arrest, uneasy alliance — he needs a thief to reach Cael Morath, she needs his ward-sense. Neither trusts the other. Beat: prickly chemistry.

chapters.title: Memories Are Currency
chapters.summary: Lena's POV. In refugee camp Ashfall, survivors trade recollections for bread. Lena witnesses a mother selling her wedding day. Beat: moral weight of Lena's trade made flesh.

chapters.title: The Gray Choir Sings
chapters.summary: Sef's POV. Flashback to Sef's induction: the Choir promised order, took his oath, hollowed his doubts. He reports Lena's location, then lies about it. Beat: first betrayal of duty.

chapters.title: Crows Remember Everything
chapters.summary: Lena's POV. A talking crow named Ossifrage, last familiar of Vael's royal aviary, recognizes the stolen memory humming in Lena's skull. It wants it back. Beat: comic menace, first hint the theft matters cosmically.

chapters.title: The Queen's Last Word
chapters.summary: Ossifrage's tale, framed through Lena's POV. The dying queen spoke Vael's true name into a single memory and hid it in her vault — the vault Lena robbed years ago unknowingly. Beat: awe and dread.

chapters.title: River of Forgotten Names
chapters.summary: Lena and Sef's shared POV alternating. Crossing the Lethe-wood where trees drink identity; Sef nearly loses himself, Lena anchors him with a memory of their shared past. Beat: intimacy forced by danger.

chapters.title: Ashfall Burns
chapters.summary: Lena's POV. The Choir razes the refugee camp seeking the name-bearer. Lena saves the mother from chapter 8 but cannot save her sold memories. Beat: guilt crystallizing into purpose.

chapters.title: Confession at the Ford
chapters.summary: Sef's POV. Sef admits he reported Lena once already; the Choir knows their route. Lena's fury; Sef's shame. Beat: trust broken and rebuilt on harder terms.

chapters.title: The Hollow's Anatomy
chapters.summary: Lena's POV. Scholar-ghost Ilvane, haunting a library that no longer exists, explains the Hollow: it is Vael's unspoken grief, born when the queen died nameless. Beat: revelation reframing the quest.

chapters.title: To Steal a Kingdom
chapters.summary: Lena's POV. New plan: not escape, restoration — carry the queen's memory to the lost heir and speak the name at the First Door. Sef resists: the heir is a Choir legend, a traitor. Beat: stakes inverted.

chapters.title: The Heir Who Chose Chains
chapters.summary: Sef's POV. Reveal: Sef IS the heir, blood of the queen, sworn to the Choir to spare his life and ignorant of it himself — his lineage was stolen from him. Beat: devastating irony.

chapters.title: Market of Secondhands
chapters.summary: Lena's POV. In the gray bazaar between worlds, Lena buys back the mother's wedding day at ruinous cost: three of their own warmest memories. Beat: sacrifice begins.

chapters.title: What Lena Cannot Recall
chapters.summary: Sef's POV. Sef notices gaps — Lena has forgotten their sister's face, the taste of honey. He starts keeping a written ledger of Lena for them. Beat: love expressed as record-keeping.

chapters.title: The Choir's Offer
chapters.summary: Lena's POV. Choir leader Mother Vesper offers Lena everything back plus Vael restored — if they surrender the name-memory to the Hollow willingly. Temptation with a catch: Vael would return empty, a husk. Beat: seduction of the easy ending.

chapters.title: Ledger of Small Kindnesses
chapters.summary: Sef's POV. Reading Lena's own ledger entries read aloud to them, Lena weeps at kindnesses they can't remember earning. Beat: quiet midpoint heartbreak.

chapters.title: Ambush at the Singing Stones
chapters.summary: Dual POV. Choir ambush; Brannoc dies buying them time, his last words Lena's real name — which even Lena had forgotten. Beat: fury and grief.

chapters.title: Burial Without a Name
chapters.summary: Lena's POV. They bury Brannoc under a cairn carved blank. Lena vows to remember everyone the Hollow takes. Beat: vow as turning point.

chapters.title: Into the Drowned City
chapters.summary: Lena's POV. Cael Morath rises from black water, lit by drowned stars kept in jars. Beauty amid ruin. Beat: wonder rekindled.

chapters.title: The First Door
chapters.summary: Sef's POV. They find the gate — sealed, needing a royal blood-price and a spoken name. Sef conceals that his blood qualifies. Beat: secret as ticking bomb.

chapters.title: Vesper's Web
chapters.summary: Lena's POV. Mother Vesper captures Ossifrage and offers a trade: the crow for the name. Lena refuses; Ossifrage escapes anyway, wounded. Beat: hardening against manipulation.

chapters.title: Blood Remembers
chapters.summary: Sef's POV. At the door, Sef cuts his palm; the lock tastes his lineage and blazes. Lena realizes the truth of his birth. Betrayal-feeling without betrayal-intent. Beat: confrontation.

chapters.title: You Lied With Your Silence
chapters.summary: Lena's POV. Furious argument in the dark before the door. Lena accuses; Sef says he feared being used as a key, not a person. Beat: love against duty stated plainly.

chapters.title: The Hollow Finds Them
chapters.summary: Dual POV. The Hollow arrives — vast, silent, wearing the faces of everyone it ate. It offers Lena their stolen memories back, one by one, as bait. Beat: climax pressure.

chapters.title: The Price of Survival
chapters.summary: Lena's POV. Lena understands: opening the door requires giving up something irreplaceable. Their whole hoard of kept memories — including every memory of Sef — must feed the lock. Beat: choice made.

chapters.title: Speak the Name
chapters.summary: Sef's POV. Lena pours their memories into the door and speaks the queen's word; Sef adds his blood and renounces the Choir aloud. The door opens onto the wound where Vael was. Beat: climax.

chapters.title: A Country Reborn, A Thief Emptied
chapters.summary: Lena's POV. Vael floods back into existence — stars, wards, songs — but Lena stands blank inside it, not knowing why everyone weeps at their arrival. Beat: hollow victory.

chapters.title: Stranger at My Own Hearth
chapters.summary: Sef's POV. Sef tends the amnesiac Lena, reading them their own ledger nightly. Grief and devotion intertwined. Beat: tender aftermath.

chapters.title: One Memory Kept
chapters.summary: Sef's POV. Reveal: when the door fed, Sef secretly substituted one of his own memories — their first meeting — so something of them survives somewhere. Beat: love's quiet arithmetic.

chapters.title: The Queen's Vault Opens
chapters.summary: Lena's POV. Restored court offers Lena anything. Lena asks only for work: rebuilding the memory-guild as healers instead of thieves. Beat: purpose reborn.

chapters.title: Mother Vesper's End
chapters.summary: Sef's POV. Vesper, half-hollowed, tries to unname Vael again; Sef and Lena stop her, and the Hollow finally takes her — gently, as if owed. Beat: closure without cruelty.

chapters.title: Learning Myself Again
chapters.summary: Lena's POV. Lena re-meets their own life: the sister found alive, the friends, the flaws. Some things don't return; some new things grow in the gaps. Beat: acceptance.

chapters.title: Where the Wards Sing
chapters.summary: Lena's POV. On the Thornfell pass, the wards hum a melody Lena almost remembers. Sef hums the missing line — the memory he kept. Beat: recognition dawning.

chapters.title: When the Hollow Sings Anew
chapters.summary: Dual POV converging. The Hollow, fed honestly at last, transforms into the country's chorus — grief transmuted into song. Lena and Sef stand together at the border as stars wheel overhead. Beat: catharsis.

chapters.title: A Ledger With Blank Pages
chapters.summary: Lena's POV. Epilogue: Lena writes the first entry in a new ledger — not what was taken, but what they'll make. Final line echoes the opening heist, now chosen freely. Beat: hopeful close.
